contracts.observation_prompt: Read only the current facts and question. Identify the literal employer and employee named by the question; collect every expressly stated family relation as a tuple (owner, literal relation word, relative), without reversing or legally classifying it; and report whether the text expressly states that the identified employee performed work for or was employed by the identified employer. Attach exact nonempty verbatim quotes from the current facts or question to every observation. Use unknown when a requested fact cannot be established; absence of a family mention is not a negative relation fact. Do not decide whether the statutory clause applies or provide the final answer.

Extract a finite factual record from only the current facts and question. Identify the exact claimant named in the question and the queried calendar year. Extract each distinct remuneration or service event with its literal payer, payee, amount, inclusive canonical start and end dates, the text's characterization of the labor, and whether the text expressly characterizes the entire amount as wages. Preserve null for unresolved labor or wage characterization, do not allocate a cross-year amount between years, and do not duplicate it. Set extraction status to resolved only when all potentially relevant supplied payment records and their required fields were extracted unambiguously; otherwise use unknown or failed. Attach exact nonempty verbatim current-case quotes. Do not total amounts, test the threshold, determine employer status, or provide the final answer.

Extract only residence facts from the current facts and question. Identify the exact proposed child, taxpayer, and queried taxable year named in the question. Record every supplied interval during which explicitly listed persons shared the same home, using inclusive canonical start and end dates. Keep separate observations as separate events; do not calculate duration, infer a principal-abode legal conclusion, or decide qualifying-child status. Set extraction status to resolved only when all supplied residence observations and their dates were extracted unambiguously; otherwise use unknown or failed. Attach exact nonempty verbatim quotes from the current facts or question to every role and event. Do not provide the final answer.

value.rationale: The contracts separate factual extraction from the unchanged legal kernels. The family adapter repairs the observed argument-frame reversal by projecting each literal kinship tuple into the employer-to-employee direction; parent-to-child inversions remain gender-neutral alternatives. The threshold and residence adapters request finite, witness-bound event records, preserve extraction uncertainty explicitly, and leave all statutory tests to their kernels.
